vocabulary.definition: to officially end a law, system, or custom
vocabulary.example: The government decided to abolish the outdated policy.

vocabulary.definition: the capacity to have an effect on the character, development, or behavior of someone or something

vocabulary.definition: a promise or firm decision to do something

vocabulary.definition: to withstand the action or effect of something
